title: Protein Variability Patterns in Ovarian Serous Carcinoma.
snippet: Protein variability patterns in cancer reflects both technical variation and biological heterogeneity and may provide information beyond mean abundance changes. We analyzed protein-level coefficients of variation across four ovarian cancer proteomic datasets, comparing controls and cancer samples.
